Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed site plans and building data; robust condition assessments covering major systems and connection to student outcomes; detailed assessments for all schools including portables and permanent buildings (e.g., Abraham Lincoln, Albert F. Biella, etc.) with condition ratings and modernization plans (multiple pages).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections through 2030 with methodology explained; includes demographic trends, birth data, residential development impact, and capacity analysis by site; clear connection between enrollment projections and facility planning (Demographic Analysis & Enrollment Projections Study, Appendix A).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational Facilities Guidelines updated with district mission and goals; detailed educational specifications for all school types; clear integration of educational goals with facility projects (e.g., STEM labs, flexible classrooms, CTE, special education); projects linked to educational needs and programs across all schools.

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: District-wide data on outdoor spaces including square footage, surface types, shade coverage, and stormwater management; detailed strategies for campus greening such as shade structures, permeable surfaces, outdoor classrooms, rain gardens, and school gardens at multiple sites; outdoor learning and environmental literacy emphasized.

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Plan addresses multiple climate risks including flooding and drainage issues with detailed site-level improvements; includes strategies such as shade structures and stormwater management; climate readiness is a theme in site planning and long-range planning but not fully integrated as a central priority across all documents.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Energy efficiency strategies mentioned including lighting upgrades, HVAC modernization, and renewable energy integration; references to state requirements such as Title 24 and Zero Net Energy goals; energy resilience goals discussed but comprehensive district-wide energy resilience plan not fully detailed.

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates for all projects; prioritization framework using Indicators of Quality; multiple funding sources including bonds and state programs outlined; financial sustainability and long-term maintenance costs considered; detailed budget and phasing plans provided.
